title: Northgate Tire Center Bay Work Standard — Rotation Work and Rebalancing by Mileage
content:
# Rotation work and rebalancing by mileage since the last rotation charge

**Standard.** On a Northgate Tire Center package, the work charged for a rotation visit depends on the miles from the odometer of the last rotation charge booked on the package (or, where none is booked, from the installation odometer) to the odometer on the rotation entry — the most recent rotation entry recorded on the package:

| Miles since the last rotation charge (or installation) | Rotation work charge |
|---|---|
| more than the package's largest rotation gap allowed for a treadwear claim (7500 miles on every package) | the rotation fee plus the rebalancing fee per tire for every tire in the set, because an overdue set is rebalanced in full |
| more than the package's recommended rotation interval (5000 miles on every package) and at most 7500 miles | the rotation fee plus the rebalancing fee per tire for the number of tires in the set divided by 2 — the pair moved to the front axle |
| 5000 miles or fewer | the rotation fee alone |

**One entry for the visit.** Rebalancing done on a rotation visit is neither a separate per-tire charge nor an entry of its own: it is part of the rotation work charge booked in the one rotation-and-balancing entry, and whatever rate the rotation charge carries scales it together with the rotation fee. This exception governs only that rotation-and-balancing entry; the make-up of every other entry is settled by the rule that books that entry, and a fee that no rule folds into another entry stays its own entry at its own fee.

**Rounding.** The rotation charge is worked on the unrounded work charge and rounded to the cent once, at the end.

## Reading the mileage

- The starting odometer is that of the latest rotation charge already booked on the package; where the package shows no rotation charge, it is the installation odometer.
- The fee figures are those of the package held: its rotation fee per visit and its rebalancing fee per tire.

## Worked figures (hypothetical fees: rotation $20.00, rebalancing $12.00 per tire; 4-tire set)

| Miles since the last rotation charge | Work charge |
|---|---|
| 8000 | 20.00 plus 12.00 for each of 4 tires: $68.00 |
| 7500 | 20.00 plus 12.00 for 2 tires: $44.00 |
| 6000 | 20.00 plus 12.00 for 2 tires: $44.00 |
| 5000 | $20.00 |
